gaps.claim: Step 2 says "Fingerprints come from the newest run record in state/runs/". Any pytest invocation writes a run record, including this skill's own step-0 `pytest tests/meta -q`. Tonight the newest record was run-20260909T203159Z-77ca5a1 with 398 results, ALL of them tests/meta. Taken literally the audit scope becomes whatever that partial run collected: every vendor-facing check reads as 'not in this record' and is silently skipped, while 206 meta checks read as 'never audited'. Rule 1's shape -- a partial run must not stand in for a full one -- applied to the pass's own scoping. The fix used tonight: for each nodeid take its newest fingerprint across all run records.

Nothing filters nodeids whose test no longer exists. 72 of the 587 nodeids carrying a fingerprint in state/runs/ are dead -- tests/meta/test_pipeline_migration.py was deleted today, tests/meta/test_deep_pass_handover.py earlier. An unfiltered scope dispatches auditors to read functions that are not there, and they cannot report that as anything but confusion. Filter against `pytest --collect-only -q`.

SEVERE, and it is this afternoon's work. The guard reads retrospective {last: null, done: false} as 'the week was due and this pass did not do it' and fails. But that is the state of EVERY pass from step 0, where the file is opened, until step 11, where Tyden runs. Verified red just now against this run's own in-progress file. Step 6 runs `pytest tests/repo` BEFORE Tyden, and step 9 reverts the run's commits on a red that cannot be resolved -- so a pass following its own spine literally would revert its whole night because of a test written hours earlier. The guard cannot tell 'in progress' from 'skipped'. Rule 8's shape, missed in the file that quotes rule 8. Proposed fix: the pass writes finished:true as its last progress write; an unfinished file dated today is inconclusive (a pass is running), an unfinished file older than that is failed (a pass died without finishing), so the hole does not become an escape hatch. meta_tests.end=null did NOT raise, and the missing severity/real_votes keys from yesterday's shape are not read -- both checked.
